Workflow.Name: BN 1 - Draft Briefing Note
Workflow.Description: Starts when a briefing request is Submitted, Info Provided or Revision Requested: runs the Briefing Note Writer (GitHub Copilot harness). It either asks the requester for clarification (Needs Info) or renders the draft PDF to SharePoint and sends it to the reviewer (In Review).
